1..10
ok 1 the shipped .claude/ template carries no absolute home path
ok 2 this project's own TRACKED .claude/ stack carries no absolute home path
ok 3 settings.json needs no substitution and is byte-identical to the template
ok 4 the canon engine has no INTENT_HOME substitution left to reintroduce it
ok 5 a scaffolded project's hooks are portable and actually run
ok 6 the hook runner passes stdin and the exit code through untouched
ok 7 the treeindex cache is not tracked, and the ignore rule keeps it that way
ok 8 the canon gitignore seam carries the treeindex rule to a consumer
ok 9 an already-tracked consumer cache is REPORTED, never untracked for them
ok 10 an unknown hook name is refused by name, not left to the shell
